description: Normative semantics for evaluation kinds referenced in rules.json. Adapted from Factory Droid alignment-training-spec v1.

json_schema.algorithm: Load schema; validate artifactJson; pass iff valid.

all_of.algorithm: Pass iff every child condition passes; short-circuit on first failure.

array_nonempty.algorithm: Resolve pointer; value must be array with length >= 1.

string_nonempty.algorithm: Resolve pointer; value must be string with trim length >= 1.

set_subset.algorithm: If asKeys: every element of leftArray exists as key in rightObject. Else: every element of left is in right set.

regex_all_match.algorithm: Compile regex; every string must match fully (use ^...$ in regex field).

markdown_contains_all.algorithm: For each VAL id in needles, contractText must contain that exact substring.

verification_steps_covered.algorithm: For each non-empty step S: exists command C in commandsRun where C.command includes S as substring. Empty verificationSteps: rule is na.

json_pointer_all.algorithm: Resolve pointer to array; each item must satisfy itemRule (e.g. requiredKeys check).

object_keys_exist.algorithm: Pass iff object has every required key.

conditional_integrity.algorithm: If when matches artifact, evaluate then; else na.

consistency_warning.algorithm: If when satisfied, emit warning if warnIf holds; does not reduce score.

file_exists.algorithm: Resolve template with feature fields; check file exists on disk. Agent Studio extension.

jsonPointer.notes: Escape ~0 and ~1 per RFC; root is empty string.
